development_data: every configuration below was chosen on train/validation only

data.catalog: videos in the standard train + validation logs (data/processed/test_phase/candidate_videos.csv)
data.known_users: users in the standard train + validation logs (data/processed/test_phase/training_users.csv)
data.edges: B_uv = 1 if the user had any long_view=1 event with the video in train + validation; repeats collapsed
data.cutoff_T: maximum time_ms in train + validation; used by every time-weighted formula

popularity.score: number of long_view=1 events per video in train + validation

freshness.score: upload_dt from video_features_basic_1k.csv, newest first; missing dates last
freshness.ties: more train + validation long-view events first, then ascending video_id

time_popularity.score: sum over the video's train + validation long views of exp(-(T - t)/tau), tau = 0.5 days (t, T in days)

bpr.penalty: gaussian (touches divided by expected touches deg + m E / N)
bpr.negative_sampling: uniform over catalog per edge, rejecting training edges
bpr.seeding: torch.manual_seed(seed) and numpy default_rng(seed) before training

ials_binary.solver: alternating exact solves via Gram-matrix identity, users then items each iteration
ials_binary.init: torch.manual_seed(seed); X ~ 0.01 N(0,1); Y ~ 0.01 N(0,1) for videos with edges, 0 otherwise

ials_time.confidence_on_edges: 1 + alpha * log(1 + sum over the pair's long views of exp(-(T - t)/tau))

hyperparameters: transferred unchanged from validation; not retuned for the longer training period
retrieval: exact full-catalog scoring in blocks of 8192 with a running top-K merge (retrieval_eval.exact_top100); continuous-score ties follow torch.topk order and are not otherwise broken

evaluation.targets: unique (user, video) pairs with long_view=1 in test, for known users and catalog videos
evaluation.cohort: known users with at least one in-catalog test target

settings.unfiltered: all catalog videos are eligible, including ones the user already long-viewed
settings.filtered: exclude every video the user long-viewed in train + validation (long views only, not all exposures); history is frozen at T and not updated during test; exclusion is applied to the full catalog before taking the top K; target denominators are identical to the unfiltered setting; report the number and share of targets made unreachable

evaluation.coverage: share of all test long-view pairs that belong to known users and catalog videos

comparisons.primary: filtered setting, Recall@100: ials_time vs time_popularity
comparisons.key_secondary: filtered setting, Recall@100: ials_time vs ials_binary
other_secondary: the same two comparisons in the unfiltered setting
all models at K = 20/50/100 in both settings

statistics.aggregation: per-user recall averaged over the five seeds for seeded models
statistics.interval: paired user bootstrap of the mean per-user difference, 2000 resamples, numpy default_rng(2026)
statistics.interpretation: intervals reflect user sampling uncertainty; training-seed variability is reported separately as the SD of the five seed-level means

random_test_supplement.sample: random_test exposures of known users and catalog videos; no seen filter
random_test_supplement.metric: per-user AUC (rank-based, ties averaged) over users with both long_view=1 and long_view=0 exposures; seeded models average per-user AUC over seeds
random_test_supplement.comparisons: ials_time vs each other model, paired user bootstrap (2000, seed 2026)
random_test_supplement.report: eligible exposures, long-view rate, users with both outcomes, differences and intervals
random_test_supplement.role: supplementary; not used to select or change models

commitment: one frozen test evaluation; the plan is not adjusted based on results. An implementation error is documented, fixed, and the evaluation rerun; erroneous results are archived, not kept as final.
